description: ClearExams current-affairs notes for 28 October 2026: twelve verified developments across governance, economy, Tamil Nadu, international relations, health, environment, water management and defence, with sixteen original exam-style MCQs.

stories.title: Cabinet approves Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31. The initiative will support integrated Gram Panchayat Development Plans, digital access to scheme and asset information, capacity-building, online audits and public disclosure through existing Panchayat systems.
key_facts: The approved outlay is ₹7,395.55 crore: ₹4,869.48 crore as the Central share and ₹2,526.07 crore as the State share.
Around 32 lakh elected representatives, Panchayat functionaries and other stakeholders across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats and Traditional Local Bodies are direct beneficiaries.
The scheme targets 2.55 lakh holistic Gram Panchayat Development Plans and at least 2.55 lakh online audit plans each year.
PANCHAM is an AI-enabled, multilingual, two-way communication platform operating in 17 Indian languages.
Implementation will be through State Governments and Union Territory administrations using approved Annual Action Plans.
stories.exam_link: Revise Part IX of the Constitution, the 73rd Constitutional Amendment, Gram Sabhas, the Eleventh Schedule and the distinction between Central Sector and Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
stories.source_title: Cabinet approves Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Cabinet approves Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme
stories.summary: The Cabinet approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme with a ₹10,000-crore outlay up to 2039-40. It supports new container factories and expansion of existing units through interest subvention, operational assistance and testing infrastructure, aiming to reduce import dependence and strengthen maritime supply chains.
key_facts: The scheme envisages increasing annual domestic container manufacturing capacity about tenfold to 7.5 lakh TEUs.
Eligible term loans for greenfield facilities and brownfield expansion can receive 3% annual interest subvention.
Operational assistance applies to eligible containers manufactured to global shipping standards and sold by eligible producers.
The Government estimates about 3,000 direct and more than 50,000 indirect jobs.
TEU means Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit, a standard measure of container capacity.
stories.exam_link: Connect container manufacturing with port-led development, logistics costs, EXIM trade, supply-chain resilience and the role of standardised TEUs in maritime transport statistics.
stories.source_title: Cabinet approves Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Cabinet clears Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme to promote investment, technology adoption, research, skills, quality certification and exports in the sports-goods sector. The scheme was announced in the Union Budget 2026-27 and is intended to build a globally competitive manufacturing ecosystem.
key_facts: The approved outlay is ₹1,856.67 crore for the period from 2026 to 2033-34.
The scheme supports investment, manufacturing, innovation, exports and integration with global value chains.
Its design includes support for research, skill development, quality certification and market development.
The initiative is aligned with Khelo Bharat Niti 2025, Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat.
stories.exam_link: Revise the division of responsibilities for sports in India, the role of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, and how quality certification and export promotion support manufacturing competitiveness.
stories.source_title: Cabinet approves Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Industrial production grows 6.7% in September 2026
stories.summary: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation released the Quick Estimate of the Index of Industrial Production for September 2026. Overall industrial output grew 6.7% year-on-year, slower than the 8.0% quick estimate for August, while manufacturing and electricity-and-gas supply recorded strong positive growth.
key_facts: The September 2026 IIP quick estimate stood at 124.3, compared with 116.5 in September 2025.
Manufacturing grew 7.6%, while Electricity and Gas Supply grew 11.2% year-on-year.
Capital goods grew 10.4%, intermediate goods 12.2% and infrastructure or construction goods 7.2% under use-based classification.
Seventeen of the 23 manufacturing industry groups recorded positive year-on-year growth.
Quick estimates remain subject to revision as source agencies provide updated production data.
stories.exam_link: Revise the IIP as a high-frequency measure of industrial output, its sectoral and use-based classifications, the role of MoSPI and the difference between an index level and a growth rate.
stories.source_title: Quick Estimates of Index of Industrial Production for September 2026 — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Thoothukudi mega shipyard partners agree next project steps
stories.summary: Indian and South Korean partners discussed the next steps for the proposed greenfield mega shipyard at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. A Joint Working Group will oversee development, the parties will work on a joint-venture structure and the Detailed Project Report is expected within six months. The shipyard is not yet operational and its capacity remains subject to DPR validation.
key_facts: The proposed investment is about US$4 billion.
The envisaged annual capacity is approximately 2.5 million Gross Tonnage, subject to the DPR.
HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering reiterated its intent to participate as the primary strategic investor.
NSHIP-TN is to facilitate waterfront land, enabling infrastructure, utilities and coordination for statutory approvals.
The plan emphasises technology transfer, workforce skilling and collaboration with Indian industry and academic institutions.
stories.exam_link: Locate Thoothukudi on the Gulf of Mannar and revise V.O. Chidambaranar Port, gross tonnage, greenfield versus brownfield projects and India-Republic of Korea maritime cooperation.
stories.source_title: India’s Thoothukudi Mega Shipyard Picks Up Pace — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign 4.0 launched nationwide
stories.summary: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare launched the fourth 60-day Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign. It seeks to prevent youth initiation, support cessation, strengthen enforcement and expand tobacco-free environments, with universities and colleges receiving special emphasis for campus compliance and youth-led awareness.
key_facts: The six-part strategy covers awareness, tobacco-free educational institutions, tobacco-free villages, enforcement, digital outreach and higher-education engagement.
The campaign will reinforce implementation of COTPA, 2003 and the Prohibition of Electronic Cigarettes Act, 2019.
Across the previous three editions, more than 5.8 lakh educational institutions and 73,000 villages were declared tobacco-free.
Section 4 of COTPA prohibits smoking in public places, subject to the Act and its rules.
The programme uses a whole-of-government approach involving Union ministries, States, educational institutions and enforcement agencies.
stories.exam_link: Revise COTPA, the electronic-cigarette prohibition law, public-health regulation, tobacco-free educational institution guidelines and the respective roles of Union, State and local authorities.
stories.source_title: Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign 4.0 launched — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Punah Bharan application launched for groundwater recharge planning
stories.summary: The Jal Shakti Minister launched the Punah Bharan mobile application, developed by BISAG-N with the National Water Mission and the Department of Water Resources. The platform uses geospatial information to identify potential artificial-recharge zones and suggest suitable structures for local groundwater-management planning.
key_facts: The mobile application can identify potential artificial-recharge zones within a radial distance of up to 3 km.
Its inputs include rainfall, groundwater levels, groundwater yield, slope and drainage data.
The associated web portal provides village-level recharge-structure zonation maps, GIS tools and thematic layers.
BISAG-N is the Bhaskaracharya National Institute for Space Applications and Geo-informatics.
The National Water Mission functions under the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
stories.exam_link: Connect artificial recharge with aquifers, watershed management, GIS and remote sensing, and distinguish recharge structures from groundwater extraction infrastructure.
stories.source_title: Union Jal Shakti Minister launches Punah Bharan Mobile Application — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: India and Mexico formally launch PTA negotiations
stories.summary: India and Mexico signed Terms of Reference that formally launch negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement. The document sets the framework, scope, modalities and roadmap for talks. No trade agreement has yet been concluded; market access and other commitments remain subject to negotiation.
key_facts: Negotiating areas include goods market access, rules of origin, customs procedures, trade facilitation and dispute settlement.
The scope also covers sanitary and phytosanitary measures, technical barriers to trade and trade remedies.
Potential cooperation sectors include automobiles, chemicals, electronics, pharmaceuticals, agri-food, energy, critical minerals and medical devices.
A proposed Mexican business mission to India in the first quarter of 2027 was discussed but not confirmed as a completed visit.
stories.exam_link: Differentiate a preferential trade agreement from a free trade agreement and customs union, and revise rules of origin, SPS measures and technical barriers under the WTO framework.
stories.source_title: India and Mexico launch PTA negotiations and sign Terms of Reference — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: NHRC issues advisory on female inmates and their children
stories.summary: The National Human Rights Commission issued an advisory to nine Union ministries and to Chief Secretaries, administrators and police chiefs of all States and Union Territories. It seeks gender-responsive prison conditions, healthcare, legal aid, family contact, rehabilitation and protection of the best interests of children living with or separated from prisoners.
key_facts: The advisory groups its recommendations into ten broad areas covering entry into prison, records, health, living conditions, children, family contact, legal aid, court production, reintegration and foreign nationals.
The NHRC requested Action Taken Reports from the concerned authorities within two months.
The advisory is a rights-protection recommendation; it is not itself a new penal statute.
NHRC is a statutory body established under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993, the composition and recommendatory role of NHRC, prison administration as a State subject and constitutional protections for persons in custody.
stories.source_title: NHRC advisory on protection of female inmates and their children — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: Central team to investigate firearm-pellet death of Kuno cheetah
stories.summary: The Environment Ministry deputed a high-level Central team to investigate the death of a 19-month-old male cheetah associated with Kuno National Park after firearm pellets were recovered during surgery. The Madhya Pradesh Government also constituted a Special Task Force. The inquiry is ongoing, and responsibility has not been determined in the official release.
key_facts: The cheetah, identified as KNG22 and an offspring of Nirva, was found injured on 25 October in territorial forest outside Kuno National Park.
Five firearm pellets were recovered during surgery; the animal died on 27 October 2026.
The Central team includes officers of the National Tiger Conservation Authority and Wildlife Crime Control Bureau.
The team will examine evidence, security protocols, monitoring and protection measures before submitting recommendations.
stories.exam_link: Revise Project Cheetah, Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh, NTCA’s statutory basis under the Wildlife Protection Act and WCCB’s role against organised wildlife crime.
stories.source_title: Central team to investigate cheetah death due to firearm-pellet injuries — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: India and United States review ten-year defence framework
stories.summary: The Indian Defence Minister and the United States defence leadership met on the sidelines of the 13th ADMM-Plus in Cebu, Philippines. They reviewed progress under the ten-year India-US Defence Framework and discussed military exchanges, maritime security, technology and information sharing, co-production and stronger defence supply chains.
key_facts: The meeting took place on 28 October 2026 on the sidelines of ADMM-Plus in Cebu.
The two sides discussed operational readiness, technology sharing and defence-industrial integration.
Both sides reiterated cooperation against terrorism and support for a free, open and secure Indo-Pacific.
ADMM-Plus connects ASEAN defence ministers with eight dialogue partners, including India and the United States.
stories.exam_link: Revise ASEAN, ADMM-Plus, India’s Act East policy and the distinction between a bilateral defence framework, a military alliance and a treaty-based collective-security commitment.
stories.source_title: India and US review ten-year Defence Framework at ADMM-Plus — PIB, 28 October 2026

stories.title: DRI intercepts 45 live reptiles at Trichy Airport
stories.summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence and the Air Intelligence Unit at Trichy intercepted two passengers arriving from Bangkok via Colombo and recovered 45 sedated live reptiles concealed in 27 food packets. The animals were seized and the passengers were arrested under the Customs Act, 1962; the case remains subject to investigation and legal proceedings.
key_facts: The recovery comprised 23 corn snakes, 16 ball pythons, five Argentine black-and-white tegus and one snow-white iguana.
The interception concerned passengers who arrived at Trichy International Airport on 26 October 2026.
DRI is the apex anti-smuggling intelligence and investigation agency under the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs.
The official release records arrest under the Customs Act, 1962 and does not constitute a judicial finding of guilt.
stories.exam_link: Connect the case with the Customs Act, DRI and CBIC, CITES-related wildlife-trade controls and the difference between seizure, arrest, prosecution and conviction.
stories.source_title: DRI busts wildlife-smuggling racket at Trichy Airport — PIB, 28 October 2026

mcqs.question: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana has been approved as which type of scheme?
mcqs.explanation: The Cabinet approved PM VGSY as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31, with both Central and State shares.

mcqs.question: Which digital platform is targeted for annual preparation of holistic Gram Panchayat Development Plans under PM VGSY?
mcqs.explanation: PM VGSY targets 2.55 lakh holistic GPDPs annually on the eGramSwaraj platform.

mcqs.question: The Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme targets annual domestic capacity of up to how many TEUs?
mcqs.explanation: The approved scheme envisages a roughly tenfold increase in annual domestic capacity to 7.5 lakh TEUs.

mcqs.question: What does TEU denote in maritime-container statistics?
mcqs.explanation: TEU stands for Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit, the standard measure used to describe container capacity.

mcqs.question: What is the approved outlay of the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme?
mcqs.explanation: The Cabinet approved an outlay of ₹1,856.67 crore for the period from 2026 to 2033-34.

mcqs.question: India's Index of Industrial Production grew by what rate in September 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The September 2026 IIP quick estimate recorded 6.7% year-on-year growth; 11.2% was the Electricity and Gas Supply growth rate.

mcqs.question: Which sector recorded 11.2% year-on-year growth in the September 2026 IIP release?
mcqs.explanation: Electricity and Gas Supply grew 11.2%, while manufacturing grew 7.6% in September 2026.

mcqs.question: The proposed Thoothukudi mega shipyard is being advanced with a strategic partner from which country?
mcqs.explanation: HD KSOE of the Republic of Korea reiterated its intent to participate as the primary strategic investor.

mcqs.question: Which document for the proposed Thoothukudi shipyard is expected to be finalised within six months?
mcqs.explanation: The partners expect to finalise the Detailed Project Report within six months; the project capacity remains subject to that DPR.

mcqs.question: Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign 4.0 gives special emphasis to which institutions?
mcqs.explanation: The fourth edition places universities and colleges at the centre of tobacco-free campus compliance and youth-led awareness.

mcqs.question: Which law prohibits electronic cigarettes in India?
mcqs.explanation: The Prohibition of Electronic Cigarettes Act, 2019 prohibits specified activities involving electronic cigarettes.

mcqs.question: The Punah Bharan mobile application primarily supports planning for what purpose?
mcqs.explanation: Punah Bharan uses geospatial datasets to identify potential artificial-recharge zones and suitable recharge structures.

mcqs.question: Signing Terms of Reference between India and Mexico on 28 October 2026 resulted in which immediate outcome?
mcqs.explanation: The Terms of Reference formally launched PTA negotiations; no final trade agreement or tariff abolition was completed.

mcqs.question: The NHRC requested Action Taken Reports on its female-inmates advisory within what period?
mcqs.explanation: The Commission asked the concerned authorities to submit Action Taken Reports within two months.

mcqs.question: Which two bodies are represented in the Central team investigating the Kuno cheetah's death?
mcqs.explanation: The team includes officers from the National Tiger Conservation Authority and the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau.

mcqs.question: The 28 October India-US defence meeting took place on the sidelines of which forum?
mcqs.explanation: The meeting occurred during the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus in Cebu, Philippines.
